purpose: Pilot staging for four candidate search fields before Master schema freeze.
grain: 1 row = one existing canonical Master record selected for schema pilot
policy: Candidate-only; do not expose on public Site or canonical Master yet.
Preserve existing human-readable eligibility text while testing normalized values.
Do not infer years_since_graduation_max unless the official source gives a safely computable limit.
Regional detail may contain multiple dimensions (school location, residence, origin, post-graduation service); retain raw meaning until taxonomy stabilizes.
Enrollment procedure deadlines must be collected from current-year official documents.
